name: Price Variance Analyzer
fn: Compares deducted prices vs contracts, POs and price lists
detail: Compares deducted prices against contracts, POs and price lists to identify pricing variances within tolerance. Catches under-pricing and erroneous chargebacks.
sap: SAP FSCM-DM · SD-TPM / Vistex programmes · FI-AR credit memo (FB75) · CO write-off postings
